events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit is on origin, probe coverage, T-335
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin main && git branch -r --contains 054299d1 2>&1 | head -3; git log --oneline -1 origin/main; git diff --stat origin/main -- cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts cloud/src/index.ts app/scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs cloud/admin-ui/admin.js | tail -2; grep -c "delete_in_zoom\|safe to delete" app/scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py show T-335 2>/dev/null | head -20 || grep -n '"T-335"' workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json

events.text: Code is on origin/main with no diff. Now check deployed version and T-335, then retry the approved forget.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read T-335/T-226 asks, retry production forget

events.text: Zoom still refuses for the missing scope (step 5 of the decision). Checking that T-335's ask carries the scope, and how the probe runs locally.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check T-335 scope ask and probe usage

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how past runs started the local stack

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find local stack setup for the probe
events.input: $ sed -n 1,20p app/scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs | grep -n "wrangler\|vendor-sim\|dev\|var" ; grep -n "SIM_PORT\|ZOOM.*BASE\|ZOOM_API" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -5; ls cloud/.dev.vars* 2>/dev/null; grep -n "ZOOM_API_BASE\|ZOOM_BASE" cloud/wrangler.* | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe header and dev var names
events.input: $ sed -n 2,16p app/scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs; grep -c . cloud/.dev.vars; grep -o "^[A-Z_]*" cloud/.dev.vars | tr '\n' ' '

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how Zoom base URL is configured locally
events.input: $ grep -n "base:\|ZOOM_API\|ZOOM_OAUTH\|SIM\b\|VENDOR" cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts | head -8; grep -rn "8896" cloud/scripts app/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | head -5

events.text: Local stack needs `SIM_URL`. Starting vendor-sim on 8897 and wrangler dev on 8896 in the background.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start vendor sim and wrangler dev locally
events.input: $ lsof -ti:8896,8897 | head; SIM_PORT=8897 SIM_STATE=/tmp/t245-sim.json nohup python3 cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py >/tmp/t245-sim.log 2>&1 & echo SIM $!; cd cloud && nohup npx wrangler dev --port 8896 --ip 127.0.0.1 --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8897 --persist-to /tmp/t245-wr >/tmp/t245-wr.log 2>&1 & echo WR $!

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for local stack to come up
events.input: $ for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8896/ 2>/dev/null | grep -q "[0-9][0-9][0-9]" && break; /bin/sleep 2; done; tail -4 /tmp/t245-wr.log; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "centre %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8896/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "sim %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8897/

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check migrations for local D1
events.input: $ ls migrations 2>/dev/null | tail -1; grep -n "database_name" wrangler.* | head -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply local migrations and run Zoom probe
events.input: $ yes | npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to /tmp/t245-wr 2>&1 | tail -2; cd ../app && CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8896 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8897 node scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15
